Common Service Questions

Services FAQ

Five things homeowners want to know before picking a service.

Do you handle both residential and commercial work?
Yes — every service on this page runs for both residential and commercial clients. Commercial jobs typically include a certificate of insurance on request, and multi-property property-manager pricing is available. Call {{global.phone}} or email info@{{global.domain}} to discuss.
Do you offer emergency service?
Yes. The 24/7 emergency line is answered directly by a Roubic team member. Tier 1 cities (Auburn Township, Pepper Pike, Chagrin Falls, Moreland Hills, Solon) typically get 1–2 hour after-hours response. Storm damage and tree-on-structure jobs include a full insurance-documentation packet.
Do I need to know the service name before I call?
No. Describe your situation — "there's a tree leaning over the garage," "the storm knocked one down last night," "the stump from a previous removal is still there" — and Aaron or Doug will tell you which service applies and give a free on-site estimate.
How do I get pricing for my specific job?
Free on-site estimate. Aaron or a lead foreman walks your property in person, documents access + hazards, and gives you a written estimate with a confirmed price — no trip charge, no obligation. Ballpark ranges for each service are on the service hub pages.
Which service handles my stump left over from another company's removal?
Stump Grinding. $275 minimum plus $8 per inch of stump diameter, ground to 6–12" below grade. We can also do full-excavation stump removal if you're planning to re-plant or install hardscape in that spot.
